- `perform` refuses the export before document validation or sending when the normalized return is a business return and the EIN lookup returns another client’s ID. It returns an unprocessable (422) error with `bound_account_id`. Personal returns skip this check. [ExportAsync](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:111)
- The lookup matches tax preparations by **current firm + EIN**, excludes the current client, and requires at least one associated `TaxAutomations::Document`. It has no tax-year, return-type, provider, or status filter; the newest matching preparation supplies the blocking client ID. Another firm’s record cannot block the export. [Lookup scope](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:116)
